metadata.title: GPCR cellular function I: LPAR1 antagonism
metadata.note: Raw author and database records are retained. Author CSV structure extraction is not an independent redraw of all structures. Exposure uncertainty is disclosed and is not replaced with guessed timing.

M001.context: Rat-derived B103 cells stably expressing human LPAR1; LPA-induced calcium mobilization measured with Fluo-4; 24 h compound preincubation; functional antagonism IC50.
M001.context_evidence: Author CSV and original Tables 1/2/4/5/7 plus calcium-assay method; 30 min compound 13, conflicted compound 15 and unmapped metabolites excluded.

raw_record.assay_context: B103 rat neuroblastoma stably expressing human LPAR1; 24 h preincubation; LPA-induced calcium mobilization; human receptor in rat-derived cell background

M002.context: Human TWNT-4 hepatic stellate cells; compound preincubation 1 h, then 1 uM LPA for 30 min; inhibition of MRTF-A nuclear translocation. The author reports an EC50 for this LPAR1-associated downstream functional response.
M002.context_evidence: Author structure/MRTF-A CSV; original SI Table S1 confirms MRTF-A values and Table S2 footnote TWNT4 plus 1 uM LPA. Source-specific ChEMBL CHEMBL6104090 describes nuclear translocation; author antagonist interpretation retained.

raw_record.assay_context: TWNT-4 MRTF-A response to LPA; distinguish downstream response from proximal receptor engagement

M003.context: CHO cells expressing human LPAR1; 30 min compound incubation; FLIPR calcium-mobilization assay; functional antagonist IC50.
M003.context_evidence: ChEMBL experimental assay description and activity records; SI available but original main-table values not independently re-extracted.
